correctness.rationale: Each full-support cubical cell has every tree vertex as an individual 0-cell coordinate, so its stabilizer under graph automorphisms is trivial. Rational chains are therefore sums of regular modules. The established Kozlov 2022 sphere-wedge theorem concentrates reduced homology in degree d=n-m, including d=0. Equivariant Euler–Poincaré gives [Htilde_d]=(-1)^d((chi/|G|)[QG]-[trivial]), with chi=1+(-1)^d f, proving q Reg+epsilon trivial. Maschke semisimplicity and augmentation-ideal decomposition handle even d, and exact rational coinvariants plus covering theory give quotient conclusions. Exact finite checker rebuilt six complexes and boundaries, but infinite proof does not rely on enumeration.

value.rationale: The result answers an explicitly formulated 2022 question for every star and resource count, giving all S_r Specht multiplicities; it furthermore holds for every finite tree automorphism subgroup and yields quotient rational Betti numbers and fundamental groups. Such data are not recovered from the nonequivariant homotopy type and distinguish symmetry actions on resources from actions on occupied locations. It is a mathematically motivated complete invariant, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
